find /dev/shm -type f -delete

#################
# RUN vLLM GLM-5.2-FP8 prefill worker
#################

GPU_MEM_UTIL=${PREFILL_GPU_MEM_UTIL:-$([ "${LWS_GROUP_SIZE:-1}" -gt 1 ] && echo 0.88 || echo 0.92)}

MTP_ARGS=""
if [ "${ENABLE_MTP:-1}" = "1" ]; then
  MTP_ARGS="--speculative-config {\"method\":\"mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":${MTP_NUM_TOKENS:-3}}"
fi

START_RANK=$(( ${LWS_WORKER_INDEX:-0} * DP_SIZE_LOCAL ))
KV_EVENTS_BASE=$((5557 - START_RANK))
KV_EVENTS_ARGS="--kv-events-config {\"enable_kv_cache_events\":true,\"publisher\":\"zmq\",\"endpoint\":\"tcp://*:${KV_EVENTS_BASE}\",\"topic\":\"kv@${POD_IP}:8000@zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8\"}"

case "${OFFLOADING_MODE:-off}" in
  cpu)
    KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG='{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector",
                          "kv_role":"kv_both",
                          "kv_load_failure_policy":"fail",
                          "kv_connector_extra_config":{
                            "connectors":[
                              {"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both"},
                              {"kv_connector":"OffloadingConnector","kv_role":"kv_both",
                               "kv_connector_extra_config":{
                                 "cpu_bytes_to_use":'"${KV_OFFLOAD_CPU_BYTES:-107374182400}"',
                                 "eviction_policy":"lru"
                            }}]}}'
    ;;
  tiered)
    KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG='{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector",
                          "kv_role":"kv_both",
                          "kv_load_failure_policy":"fail",
                          "kv_connector_extra_config":{
                            "connectors":[
                              {"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both"},
                              {"kv_connector":"OffloadingConnector","kv_role":"kv_both",
                               "kv_connector_extra_config":{
                                 "spec_name":"TieringOffloadingSpec",
                                 "cpu_bytes_to_use":'"${KV_OFFLOAD_CPU_BYTES:-107374182400}"',
                                 "eviction_policy":"lru",
                                 "secondary_tiers":[{"type":"fs","root_dir":"/mnt/nvme-cache",
                                   "n_read_threads":16,"n_write_threads":16}]
                            }}]}}'
    ;;
  p2p-tiered)
    P2P_BASE=$((7777 - START_RANK))
    KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG='{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector",
                          "kv_role":"kv_both",
                          "kv_load_failure_policy":"fail",
                          "kv_connector_extra_config":{
                            "connectors":[
                              {"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both"},
                              {"kv_connector":"OffloadingConnector","kv_role":"kv_both",
                               "kv_connector_extra_config":{
                                 "spec_name":"TieringOffloadingSpec",
                                 "cpu_bytes_to_use":'"${KV_OFFLOAD_CPU_BYTES:-107374182400}"',
                                 "eviction_policy":"lru",
                                 "offload_prompt_only":false,
                                 "secondary_tiers":[{"type":"p2p","host":"'"${POD_IP}"'","port":'"${P2P_BASE}"'}]
                            }}]}}'
    ;;
  *)
    KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG='{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector",
                          "kv_role":"kv_both",
                          "kv_load_failure_policy":"fail"}'
    ;;
esac

exec vllm serve $MTP_ARGS --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8 \
  --load-format runai_streamer \
  --model-loader-extra-config '{"distributed":true,"concurrency":16,"memory_limit":17179869184}' \
  --port 8000 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --gpu-memory-utilization $GPU_MEM_UTIL \
  --max-model-len ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-120000} \
  --disable-access-log-for-endpoints=/health,/metrics \
  --data-parallel-multi-port-external-lb \
  --data-parallel-supervisor-port=8208 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --tensor-parallel-size $TP_SIZE \
  --data-parallel-size $((LWS_GROUP_SIZE * DP_SIZE_LOCAL)) \
  --data-parallel-size-local $DP_SIZE_LOCAL \
  --data-parallel-address ${LWS_LEADER_ADDRESS} \
  --data-parallel-rpc-port 5555 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \
  --long-prefill-token-threshold 2048 \
  --data-parallel-start-rank $START_RANK \
  --block-size 64 \
  $KV_EVENTS_ARGS \
  --kv_transfer_config "$KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG" \
  --moe-backend deep_gemm \
  --all2all-backend deepep_high_throughput
